records.text: A psalm of David, which he sang to the Lord concerning the words of Chousi son of Iemeni.
Lord my God, in Thee I hoped. Save me from all who pursue me, and rescue me,
lest he seize my soul like a lion, with no one to redeem or save.
Lord my God, if I did this, if there is injustice in my hands,
if I repaid those who repay me evils, then may I fall away from my enemies empty,
then may the enemy pursue my soul and overtake it, trample my life into the earth, and make my glory dwell in dust. Diapsalma.
Rise, Lord, in Thine anger; be exalted within the boundaries of my enemies. Awake, Lord my God, in the ordinance which Thou didst command,
and an assembly of peoples will surround Thee; and for its sake return on high.
The Lord will judge peoples. Judge me, Lord, according to my righteousness and according to my innocence upon me.
Let sinners’ wickedness come to an end, and Thou wilt direct the righteous one, God who tests hearts and kidneys.
For the end. A psalm of David. In the Lord I have trusted. How will you say to my soul, “Move away to the mountains like a little bird”?
For behold, sinners bent a bow; they prepared arrows for a quiver, to shoot down in the moonless dark the upright in heart.
For what Thou didst establish, they pulled down; but what did the righteous person do?
The Lord is in His holy temple; the Lord’s throne is in heaven. His eyes look toward the needy; His eyelids examine the sons of men.
The Lord examines the righteous and the ungodly; but the one who loves injustice hates his own soul.
He will rain traps upon sinners; fire, sulfur, and a storm wind are the portion of their cup.
For the Lord is righteous and loved righteous deeds; His face beheld uprightness.
Arise, Lord; get ahead of them and trip them up; rescue my soul from an ungodly man, Thy sword from the enemies of Thy hand.
Lord, separate them from the few, from the earth, during their life. Their belly was filled with Thy hidden things; they were satisfied with sons and left the remains to their infants.
But I, in righteousness, will appear before Thy face; I will be satisfied when Thy glory appears.
Now I know that the Lord saved His anointed; He will hear him from His holy heaven; in mighty acts is the salvation of His right hand.
These rely on chariots, and those on horses, but we will be magnified in the name of the Lord our God.
They were fettered and fell, but we rose and were set upright.
Lord, save Thy king, and hear us on whatever day we call upon Thee.
Make Thy ways known to me, Lord, and teach me Thy paths.
Guide me into Thy truth and teach me, for Thou art God my Savior, and I waited for Thee the whole day.
Remember Thy compassions, Lord, and Thy mercies, for they are from eternity.
Do not remember the sins of my youth or my acts of ignorance; according to Thy mercy, remember me Thyself, for Thy kindness’ sake, Lord.
The Lord is kind and upright; therefore He will give sinners instruction in the way.
He will guide the meek in judgment; He will teach the meek His ways.
All the Lord’s ways are mercy and truth for those who seek His covenant and His testimonies.
For Thy name’s sake, Lord, Thou wilt be gracious to my sin, for it is great.
Who is the human being who fears the Lord? He will give him instruction in a way he chose.
His soul will lodge among good things, and his seed will inherit land.
The Lord is the stronghold of those who fear Him, and the Lord’s name belongs to those who fear Him, and His covenant is to make things known to them.
Of David, before being anointed. The Lord is my light and my Savior; whom will I fear? The Lord is the protector of my life; of whom will I be afraid?
When those doing evil approached me to eat my flesh, those who afflict me and my enemies, they grew weak and fell.
Even if an army draws up against me, my heart will not fear; even if war rises against me, in this I hope.
One thing I asked from the Lord; this I will seek: that I may dwell in the Lord’s house all the days of my life, that I may behold the Lord’s loveliness and visit His temple.
For He hid me in a tent in the day of my troubles; He sheltered me in the hiding place of His tent; He raised me upon a rock.
And now, behold, He raised my head above my enemies; I went around and sacrificed in His tent a sacrifice of shouting; I will sing and make music to the Lord.
Hear, Lord, my voice with which I cried; have mercy on me and hear me.
Blessed be the Lord, because He heard the voice of my petition.
The Lord is my helper and my protector; in Him my heart hoped, and I was helped, and my flesh blossomed anew; from my own will I will thank Him.
The Lord is the stronghold of His people and the protector of the salvations of His anointed.
Save Thy people and bless Thine inheritance; shepherd them and lift them up for ever.
Unjust witnesses rose up; they questioned me about what I did not know.
They repaid me evils for good things, and childlessness to my soul.
But when they troubled me, I put on sackcloth and humbled my soul with fasting; and my prayer will return to my bosom.
As for a neighbor, as for our brother, so I sought to please; like one mourning and downcast, so I humbled myself.
But against me they rejoiced and gathered; scourges gathered against me, and I did not know; they were torn apart and felt no remorse.
They tested me and mocked me with mockery; they gnashed their teeth at me.
Lord, when wilt Thou look upon this? Restore my soul from their wickedness, my only life from lions.
I will thank Thee, Lord, in a great assembly; among a weighty people I will praise Thee.
I became like a person who does not hear and has no rebukes in his mouth.
For I hoped in Thee, Lord; Thou wilt hear, Lord my God.
For I said, “Let my enemies never rejoice over me!” When my feet were shaken, they boasted against me.
For I am ready for scourges, and my pain is continually before me.
For I will announce my lawlessness and be concerned about my sin.
But my enemies live and have become stronger than I, and those hating me unjustly have multiplied.
Those repaying evils for good things slandered me because I pursued righteousness, and they cast me, the beloved, away like an abhorred corpse.
Do not abandon me, Lord; my God, do not depart from me.
Attend to my aid, Lord of my salvation.
